metadata.description: Compute the SHA-256 digest of a sequence of bytes.
comments: sha256(bytes) returns the 32-byte SHA-256 digest of bytes. Total: hashing is pure and never fails.
Pairs with hydra.core.lib.files.readFile, which returns raw bytes, to hash file contents.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.hashing.sha256.matchesKnownAnswerVectors
provisions.statement: sha256 returns the correct 32-byte SHA-256 digest for known-answer input vectors, including the empty byte sequence.

parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: the sequence of bytes to hash

metadata.description: Compute the SHA-256 digest of a sequence of bytes as a lowercase hex string.
comments: sha256Hex(bytes) returns the SHA-256 digest of bytes as a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string. Equivalent to hex-encoding the output of sha256. Total: hashing is pure and never fails.
Pairs with hydra.core.lib.files.readFile, which returns raw bytes, to hash file contents.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.hashing.sha256Hex.matchesKnownAnswerVectors
provisions.statement: sha256Hex returns the correct 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest for known-answer input vectors, including the empty byte sequence and a multi-block input.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.hashing.sha256Hex.handlesPaddingBoundariesCorrectly
provisions.statement: sha256Hex returns the correct digest at every SHA-256 message-padding boundary length (55 bytes, the largest message whose padding still fits one 64-byte block; 56 bytes, which forces a second block; and 63 and 64 bytes, straddling the block size), guarding against a padding-logic regression that would only surface at these specific lengths.

parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: the sequence of bytes to hash
